visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A pair of hands meticulously peels a bright green luffa using a black peeler over a large stainless steel bowl. Once peeled, the luffa is moved to a yellow cutting board where a large kitchen knife removes the ends and cuts the vegetable into thick, bite-sized chunks. The setting is a clean, well-lit modern kitchen with a blurred white background. (2) The focus shifts to preparing aromatics as the chef slices a piece of fresh ginger into thin discs and then fine julienne strips. In a small ceramic bowl, red dried goji berries are rinsed and then submerged in a splash of amber-colored rice wine. A white cast-iron pot sits on an induction stove, where oil is heated and the ginger strips are tossed in to sauté until fragrant. (3) The larger chunks of luffa are added to the pot and stirred with a wooden spatula. White pepper and a generous splash of wine are poured over the vegetables. A plate of fresh clams is tipped into the pot before a matching white lid with a silver knob is placed on top. Plumes of white steam begin to emerge from the edges of the pot as the contents simmer. (4) Upon lifting the lid, the clams have opened wide and the luffa has softened into a vibrant green hue, surrounded by natural juices. The soaked goji berries are stirred in for a pop of color. Finally, the female host, wearing glasses and a blue checkered apron, is shown in a medium shot tasting a spoonful of the soup from a small white bowl, looking delighted and waving at the viewer.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: @RosalinaKitchen. [Slogan]: 夏日簡單做. [Subtitle]: 無水絲瓜蛤蜊. [Slogan]: 自然鮮甜，不用調味. (2) [Subtitle]: 絲瓜去掉外皮. 去掉頭尾. (3) [Subtitle]: 先剖半. (4) [Subtitle]: 再剖半... (5) [Subtitle]: 可以切大塊一點. 口感較好! (6) [Subtitle]: 嫩薑切片... (7) [Subtitle]: 再切成絲... (8) [Subtitle]: 枸杞清洗乾淨. (9) [Subtitle]: 泡一下花雕酒... (10) [Subtitle]: 花雕酒的味道. 很淡雅喔！ (11) [Subtitle]: 開中火加熱一分鐘. (12) [Subtitle]: 倒入橄欖油... (13) [Subtitle]: 把薑絲放進來... (14) [Subtitle]: 把絲瓜放進來... (15) [Subtitle]: 翻炒一下... (16) [Subtitle]: 不用加鹽喔！一點白胡椒粉.. (17) [Subtitle]: 趁熱嗆入. 20ml花雕酒... (18) [Subtitle]: 快速放入蛤蜊250克. (19) [Subtitle]: 趕快蓋上鍋蓋... (20) [Subtitle]: 等到鍋邊冒出蒸氣... (21) [Subtitle]: 轉弱火.. 再煮3~4分鐘. (22) [Subtitle]: 好囉❤️ 就是這麼簡單！ (23) [Subtitle]: 超多湯～ (24) [Subtitle]: 最後再把. 枸杞加進來. (25) [Subtitle]: 原汁原味. 好吃的絲瓜蛤蜊. 就完成啦...❤️ (26) [Subtitle]: 不加水的. 無水絲瓜蛤蜊. 湯超甜！❤️ (27) [Subtitle]: 趕快動手試試看❤️ (28) [Subtitle]: 更多美味料理. 請追蹤我 IG. 臉書 蘿潔塔的廚房.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a cheerful, mid-tempo acoustic guitar melody accompanied by a bright piano. A clear, friendly female voice introduces the dish with high articulation. Rhythmic, percussive sounds of the peeler scraping the luffa skin and the crisp 'thwack' of a knife hitting the cutting board are layered over the music. (2) As the cooking process begins, the sound of a stove's ignition is heard, followed by a sharp sizzle as ginger strips hit hot oil. The pouring of liquid into the pot creates a distinct splashing sound. The background music remains consistent in volume, providing a warm and inviting atmosphere while the narration continues with informative clarity. (3) A dense clattering sound occurs as a large amount of clams are poured from a ceramic plate into the heavy pot. This is followed by a dull 'thud' as the lid is placed on top. A soft, continuous hissing of steam is audible as the vegetables and seafood cook in their own juices, while the narrator explains the timing. (4) The music swells slightly as the lid is removed, and the narrator's voice becomes more excited and high-pitched. A subtle, wet slurping sound is captured as she tastes the hot soup. The video ends with a melodic sign-off and a final upbeat chord from the acoustic guitar, leaving a positive and energetic impression on the listener.
